corrections: Replaced the generic cargo jet with a separately stationed C-17A: broad low nose and cargo barrel, upswept ramp, wing/body junction, swept anhedral wing, canted winglets, swept T-tail and separate wheel sponsons.

Modeled four offset F117 nacelles with recessed fans and exhausts, twelve main wheels in two three-wheel axles per side, twin nose wheels, access panels, selected skin seams and fasteners. No weapons or optional mission equipment.

Overlay iterations expanded the aft wing chord, lowered the wing tips, shortened the tail fairing and corrected the rudder outline. Replaced construction-facet glazing with two continuous front panes and four side panes, then adjusted windshield corners against the front drawing and cockpit sightline.

Rebuilt the four-display panel from the photographed arrangement, with dual standby instruments, separate AFCS/radio glareshield, four fire handles, physical HUD assemblies, four-throttle console, short sticks, pedals, blue pilot/observer seats and partitioned overhead/circuit-breaker panels.

Flight displays share bounded expressions for unit conversion, heading, digit decoding and availability. Four engine gauges read independent simulated normalized RPM, explicitly labelled SIM RPM. Flap/elevator sign checks verify downward deployment and upward elevator trailing edges for nose-up input; all swept/canted hinges remain fixed.
reviewNotes.independentDimensions: USAF factsheet: length53m, span51.75m to winglet tips, height16.79m. Manual three-view independently labels tailspan65ft/19.81m, inboard engine offset24ft10in/7.57m, outboard46ft8in/14.22m, main gear overallwidth33ft8in/10.26m, main axle spacing8ft1in/2.46m and nosegear11ft/3.35m aft of nose. Main wing area353.03m² follows AMC specification appendix3800ft². The scanned general-arrangement illustration and rounded metric labels differ slightly; all overlays use uniform scaling. Cockpit width2.70m and depth remain photographic estimates.
reviewNotes.visual: Personally inspected final source-hash side/top/front/panel overlays, all eight standard views, and twelve detail/state captures: zero, cruise, limits, negative altitude, missing telemetry, pedestal, overhead, close nose, clean gear-up, tail and both control extremes. Corrected wing, tail, glazing and control directions before final inspection.24 shared instrument tests and final targeted geometry/sightline/hash checks passed; deterministic candidate matches source bytes.
limitations: Reference three-view is a scanned general-arrangement illustration, not engineering cross-sections. Fuselage sections, wing incidence/airfoil, pylons, nose glazing and local fairings are estimated. The front drawing shows a lower aft wing/flap silhouette than the clean model; exact illustrated flap configuration is unspecified.

Cockpit scale and depth are estimated from perspective photographs. Panel positions and distinctive major assemblies are reference-based; overhead switch counts, sidewalls, seats, liners and ancillary controls remain simplified. Eyebrow windows are exterior dark insets, not transparent openings.

Display symbology is an original simulator adaptation. Readings are true airspeed, geometric altitude and true heading. HUDs have geometry but no collimated symbology; radio navigation, flight management, autopilot and weather/terrain maps are unavailable.

Engine gauges show each simulated engine normalized RPM, not calibrated F117 N1/N2. EPR, EGT, fuel, oil, hydraulic, electrical and failure indications are not simulated and remain blank rather than fabricated.

Gear retracts through translation/hiding, flaps rotate without full multi-slotted Fowler extension, and slats/reversers are not animated. Cargo ramp stays closed, the cargo hold is minimally furnished, and seams/fasteners are selective rather than a manufacturing rivet schedule. Assisted flight model is not aircraft performance certification.
